title: pre-tool writable gate misses in-place file edits by sed -i / perl -i
detail: During usage-rollup planning, the Edit tool on design/usage-rollup/scope.md was correctly blocked (not writable in planning), but a Bash 'sed -i "" s/.../.../ design/usage-rollup/scope.md' in the same turn modified the file: _bash_redirect_targets only parses shell redirects, not in-place editors (sed -i, perl -i, etc.). Repro: active sprint in planning; Bash: sed -i '' 's/a/b/' design/<f>/scope.md -> allowed, file changed. Expected: denied like the Edit.
